items: Better operations come down to three things: keeping a firm grip on costs, removing friction from every step of service and turning feedback into action.
Food waste, overstaffing and last-minute supply orders eat profit, so real-time inventory tracking, demand-based scheduling and supplier negotiation help you control spending.
Integrated POS systems, tableside ordering and efficient kitchen workflows cut slow tickets and ordering mistakes, which frees your staff to focus on guests.
Momos' Rockie agent finds which locations dropped in guest satisfaction, explains the root cause from your POS, loyalty and review data, and suggests the next step for each location.
